name: SMS Twilio Integration (beta)
author: Nick Spica (thespica93)
description: (beta) Allow viewers to text names that will appear on your light display using Twilio SMS. Installs alongside the stable version — separate data, port, and scheduler scripts, so both can run side by side. Features include message queueing, profanity filtering with customizable blacklist, name whitelist, automatic SMS responses, phone number blocking and rate limiting, and duplicate message detection. **NOTE: This is the BETA version. Plugin may not work as expected**
